verdict.rationale: API stability is a fair question for a programmable agent tool. This one exposes Shortcuts/Siri hooks and trace export, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions versioned APIs, API version numbers, or a deprecation policy. The only API reference is to consuming OpenAI-compatible endpoints, which is client-side and does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
